title: Protocol and Terminal
author: Ivo Nakamura
blurb: Xanthe Winterbourne, a clone who inherited the original's murder case, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. But when the colony's children start sharing the same dream, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must prove a massacre happened when every record says otherwise before the reactor finishes its countdown.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
